sources: Flare 2.0 新动作清单 2026-11-20（Google 表 1njBhCNMs-iliNbt3gKxDwCZnpQBxQoi-yPFRGQHmJwk，P0 双椅直臂支撑（肩胛下压））

purpose.zh: 练直臂支撑和肩往下压的力量，为双杠和托马斯支撑打底
purpose.en: Builds straight-arm support and shoulder-blade depression for parallel-bar and Thomas flair support.

text.zh: 手臂锁直，肩往下沉，别耸肩
text.en: Arms locked, shoulders down, no shrugging

text.zh: 两把一样高的椅子靠墙放稳，手掌平放在椅面上，手指朝前。
text.en: Set two equal-height chairs firmly against a wall; palms flat on the seats, fingers forward.

text.zh: 把椅面往下推，脖子拉长，身体跟着往上升一点。
text.en: Push the seats down and lengthen your neck; your body rises a little.

text.zh: 膝盖弯着，脚离地，撑不住时脚尖轻轻点地就行。
text.en: Knees bent, feet off the floor; if that is too hard, let your toes lightly touch.

commonErrors.en: Shrugging your shoulders up toward your ears.

commonErrors.zh: 身体前后晃，椅子跟着晃

cautions.zh: 椅子不稳就别撑；手腕疼就停
cautions.en: Do not use chairs that wobble; stop if your wrists hurt.

flare2.item: P0 双椅直臂支撑（肩胛下压）
flare2.plans: 17 个计划（三角肌/前臂/肱三头肌/背阔肌/胸大肌中高级；阶段 9、11/15、12、13、16 中高级）
flare2.camera: 前方偏右 25°（正面看得出肩下沉；侧面被椅子挡）
flare2.doseBrief: 表内未给剂量；草稿按 3 组 × 15 秒、休 60 秒
flare2.note: Animation (r1): relaxed support with the toes lightly on the floor -> shoulders pressed down 42 mm, body rises, feet come off the floor -> held ~4.6 s -> relax. The brief allows feet off or toes lightly touching.

set.zh: 手臂锁直，肩往下沉，别耸肩
set.en: Arms locked, shoulders down, no shrugging
